description: This Java test class verifies the display output of the Cuttlefish hardware composer (HWC) by running a binary that sets the screen to red and then checking if the screen displays red color correctly. It manages the binary execution in a separate thread, captures screenshots if the test fails, and uses JUnit for test structure.

classes.name: CuttlefishHwcRedSmokeTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the red display output on Cuttlefish hardware by running a binary and checking the screen color.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes and starts the binary that sets the display to red in a separate thread before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Stops the binary process after each test by killing it.

methods.name: testHwcRedDisplay
methods.description: Main test method that waits for the display to turn red and verifies the output, capturing a screenshot if the test fails.
